title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Sometimes, in local flight travel or international travel, the plane will be small and there would not be enough place to offer Salah standing. Breaking Knuckles (Cracking Fingers) 23349 views Q. Can we pray sunnah after the fardh salaat? 14210 views Q. About reading durood shareef in salah 17109 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum I am a Hafiz Alhamdulillah, but I have problem pronouncing the Ra sound. There is a joint below the tip of my tongue, which makes my tongue tip-less and I cannot make the Ra sound. Whenever I try to pronounce Ra, the sound of Waw comes out. I have tried a lot of time when I was small, and when I was doing Hifz but it did not improve. Now since I am a Hafiz, I am usually asked to lead the prayer when the Imam is not present in the Masjid. I want to ask whether it is ok if I lead the prayer? I cannot even pronounce Allahu Akbar properly. The sound comes out as Allahu Akbaw, but people usually don't notice. And then there will be many more mistakes in Surah Fatihah. So is my prayer valid? And what about the prayer of those who are praying behind me? I heard one 'Alim say that if Takbeere Tahreema is not proper, then a person will not even enter into the prayer. It is as if he has not started the prayer at all. What should I do then? I cannot pronounce it properly. I hope Allah will accept my prayer because I am ma'zoor, but if I am leading the prayer, will the prayer of those behind me be valid? Jazakallah Khair 2924 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 39526 Country: Bangladesh Title: I work in a government office. In 1st floor we have a mosque for our office employers Question: I work in a government office. In 1st floor we have a mosque for our office employers. This Imam is bidati person, like he says Ya Nabi Salamualika, he does Qiyam, he do not like tabligh Jamat etc. For that reason I do not go in our office mosque and I arrange a Jamah with my colleagues and others staff in our floor. Most of the staffs are not going to the mosque but when I arrange for jamah then they join us. My question is that whether it is right to arrange these Jamah or if I am wrong then what I need to do? Please suggest me. Answer ID: 39526 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1017/622/L=1433) If it is not a Shariah mosque i.e. the place is not fixed from ground to sky for the interest of the mosque then you along with your colleagues and other staff members can arrange for separate Jama’ah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
